summary.intent: Autonomously run the full post-execute-phase ship pipeline for GSD phase 68 (verify → secure → validate → simplify → SDK E2E gate → CodeRabbit review → ship → resolve PR reviews), triaging every finding without stopping to ask the user.
summary.outcome: Completed verify (accepted existing PASS), secure and validate audits, a simplify pass that found and fixed a real zeroization-order bug plus removed dead code, got the SDK E2E gate fully green after diagnosing two environment issues, and applied/committed all in-scope fixes from a local CodeRabbit review across SDK, API, and web services; the transcript ends before the PR was actually opened (steps 8-11 not reached).

repo: apps/api's TEE_WORKER_URL config defaults to :3001 locally, which is actually the mock-ipns-routing service, not the real tee-worker (on :3002) — causes silent misrouting during SDK E2E runs, not a code regression
The local tee-worker container can be running a stale pre-phase contract; must be rebuilt from current source before trusting SDK E2E TEE-path results
Conventional-commit paren rule only forbids parens in the description part — scope parens like `feat(sdk):` are valid and don't need rewording
apps/web's vitest suite (including ipns.service.test.ts) is not wired into CI at all — a pre-existing broken test there won't be caught by CI and is not a regression from any given phase
markdownlint excludes .planning/ on commit but prettier still runs against it

code.finding: enumerateMoveDescendants zeroed a parent readKey before the children loop unsealed with it, misclassifying every depth-2+ move descendant as unreadable — real bug, fixed with a red-green-verified regression test (client-move-enumerate.test.ts)

updateGrant lacked a monotonic guard on rootGeneration, allowing a stale/lower generation value to overwrite a newer one — added guard plus a new spec case since no service-level updateGrant tests existed
Contained dead functions (including ensureFreshSentShares-related code) orphaned by the rotation cutover; removed after confirming zero external references
Contained an unused exported constant/dead code path removed during the simplify pass
Multiple CodeRabbit findings applied here — raw error logs replaced with structured logging in several call sites

workflow: Running independent long steps (security audit, simplify agent, SDK E2E client-chain build) as concurrent background jobs and polling for completion kept the pipeline moving without idle waiting
When a suite fails, diagnose environment vs. code cause before treating it as a regression — here two 'failures' were stale-container and misconfigured-URL issues, not bugs
For a claimed bug fix, prove the regression test actually catches the bug by temporarily reverting the fix and confirming the test goes red, then re-applying and confirming green
CodeRabbit re-reviews the phase's own fix commits and can surface new findings on them — expect and triage a second round

friction: SDK E2E gate failed on first run for environment reasons (stale tee-worker container running a pre-Phase-67 contract, and TEE_WORKER_URL defaulting to the wrong port/service) — required substantial log-diving and container rebuilding before getting a clean green run

A web vitest failure (ipns.service.test.ts) took a long diagnostic detour — diffing against main, swapping in main's version of the file, tracing import chains — before concluding it was pre-existing and not covered by CI at all
No existing service-level test coverage for shares.service.ts updateGrant, requiring a new test to be authored from scratch to cover the monotonic-guard fix
